svg.title: MacBook Pro 14-inch (M6, Liquid Retina XDR) — silver
svg.desc: Original front-view vector illustration, MIT (LICENSE.txt). Manufacturer specifications are references for measurements and product details, not sources of artwork. US catalog, 2026-11-20. Reference SKU: MHWT4LL/A (Space Black). 14.2-inch Liquid Retina XDR; native 3024 × 1964 px. Apple display reference (1092 × 668 px), front elevation: deck/lid/display widths ≈ 1090/898/866 px; lid top y=5, display bottom y≈584, deck starts y≈618, metal ends y≈658, feet end y≈663 (exclusive ends). Native aspect retained; lid meets deck at the visible seam. Attached housing approx. 104 px wide, ending at row 42; rounded top screen corners only. Corner radii, lens, recess and underside curves are approximations; feet clearance included without drawing the feet. Finish swatches are illustrative. Sources: https://www.apple.com/macbook-pro/specs/; https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-pro; https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-pro/liquid-retina-xdr-display/specs/e/images/specs/14-inch/display_14_inch__db0ppp7h83ma_large_2x.jpg; https://www.apple.com/v/macbook-pro/liquid-retina-xdr-display/specs/e/images/specs/14-inch/macbook_pro_14_inch__fjlrd633eki2_large_2x.jpg
